contributions.detail: 15 rows sum to 1894.00; the printed TOTAL CONTRIBUTIONS on Form A and the cover's THIS REPORT cell BOTH read 1893.01 -- a 0.99 FILER ARITHMETIC ERROR, not a transcription gap. Every amount was re-read in 1200dpi column crops (~730 effective dpi) and the one candidate that would have closed the gap exactly (line 11 reading 37.50 instead of 38.49, a difference of precisely 0.99) was escalated to a single-cell 1200dpi crop and is unambiguously 38.49. The error propagates into the cover: 2077.94 + 1893.01 = 3970.95, the printed CUMULATIVE, so the filer used his wrong subtotal consistently. Rows published verbatim with needs_review on every row of the side. SCOPE IS PER-PERIOD: the rows equal the THIS REPORT cell, not the CUMULATIVE (3970.95) -- a DIFFERENT SCOPE from the cumulative figure this module publishes, so reconciles_contrib is expected to stay blank.

expenditures.detail: 16 rows sum to 2701.80, exactly the printed TOTAL EXPENDITURES and the cover's THIS REPORT cell. The gate only closed after line 5 was re-read at 1200dpi as 253.00 (a 200dpi first pass had it as 255.00) -- the arithmetic caught the misread, which is precisely the intended use of the schedule-total gate. Per-period scope; the cycle-to-date figure is the CUMULATIVE cell 3970.95.

gates.page_subtotal: p3 rows 2701.80 = printed TOTAL EXPENDITURES 2701.80, GATES EXACTLY (after the line-5 correction). p2 rows 1894.00 vs printed TOTAL CONTRIBUTIONS 1893.01 -- WILL NOT GATE; both figures named, no row adjusted.
gates.row_count: p2 rowbands.py geometry_status=ok, 19 bands = 1 header band + 17 data bands + 1 TOTAL footer band; 15 data bands inked, 2 blank, 15 rows emitted. p3 identical structure (19 bands = header + 17 data + footer); 16 inked, 1 blank, 16 rows emitted. Header and footer bands mapped explicitly and excluded.
gates.geometry_proof: p2: the row-1 amount band renders '100.00' and the row-15 band renders '500.00' (their own values); the band one pitch past row 15 renders EMPTY. p3: row-1 renders '319.35', row-16 renders '257.21', and the band one pitch past row 16 renders EMPTY. Column boundaries taken from rowbands' v_rules (p2 amount col 66.59-83.41 pct, p3 66.68-92.03 pct).
gates.balance_chain: Contributions cumulative 3970.95 - expenses cumulative 3970.95 = 0.00 = the printed line-3 CUMULATIVE balance; the LAST/THIS balance cells (808.79 and -808.79) also net to 0.00. The chain closes on the filer's OWN figures, which embed his 0.99 contribution error -- it does not close on the transcribed rows (1894.00 - 2701.80 vs the printed period figures). No earlier filing by this filer in this chunk, so no cross-filing cumulative chain could be run; the cover's own LAST REPORT column (2077.94 / 1269.15 / 808.79) is the only evidence of the prior report.

notes: A THIRD, NEWER Generation-2 variant: the 'AMERICA'S COUNTY' logo, and -- important -- ITS COVER HAS NO '$50.00 OR LESS' AGGREGATE LINE AT ALL. Only three cover lines exist (contributions over $50 from Form A, total campaign expenses from Form B, balance), so cover_le50_this / cover_le50_cum are recorded as null (the field does not exist), NOT as zero. The sub-$50 trap therefore cannot arise on this filing. Form A carries the In Kind? Y/N column and every row is answered 'N'. THE DOCUMENT DISAGREES WITH THE CHUNK FILE ON THE OFFICE: the chunk says 'Commission Seat C', but the form's 'Candidate for Office Of' line reads simply 'Washington County Commission' on all three pages -- no seat letter anywhere in the document. Transcribed from the form and flagged. Candidate 'Chuck Goode' agrees. EVERY DATE ON BOTH SCHEDULES IS MONTH-DAY ONLY, with no year printed; all are left BLANK per contract with the verbatim token in each row note (the report period is 6-13-24 to 10-28-24, but a year must never be filled from the report date). Donor addresses are street+ZIP with no city token except line 1 ('STG'); streets and ZIPs discarded at read time.
